item.title: 1.42.3b1
item.description:
⚠️ BETA RELEASE WARNING

This is an unstable pre-release version intended for testing purposes only.

🔧 Improvements & Stability

  • Clearer Alternate Shortcuts description in Settings
    • The description now appears under the Alternate Shortcuts section title, so it clearly covers the whole list
    • Find it in Settings > Gestures > Window Switcher, when "show settings descriptions" is enabled
    • Shortcuts with no modifiers selected still use the main shortcut's modifiers, as noted at the bottom of the section

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Previews missing for apps that are slow to respond
    • Apps that are launching or busy are no longer treated as frozen
    • Their window previews now appear reliably instead of being skipped
    • Apps are only treated as unresponsive after a long delay
    • Works automatically, no setting needed
